messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: pd_key=PD12345 service=runtime-latency threshold=95p window=1m. Auto-resolve policy=30s.

sam: got it, paging noise? seeing a couple similar quick pages.

maria: I'm on it — jumping to check ingress and kv warmup metrics.

alex: saw a tiny spike in proxy latency around 13:02 UTC, looks like short-lived kv cache misses from a small batch of hosts. no change in error-rate.

sam: acked the page in PD (ack @sam). marking as on-call.

incident-bot: PD escalation suppressed by noise-filter (suppression_id=sup-987). Auto-resolve triggered after 22s.

maria: logs from gke-proxy-12 show repeated lines: ```WARN kv_cache.go: miss for prefix 0xabc123, populate start```. interval ~200ms x ~8 hosts.

alex: that aligns with a small canary rollout that bumped capacity earlier. kv warmup ramped a hair too slow for short burst.

jen: any customer-facing errors? I don't see increases in 5xx in the last 10m across regions.

maria: confirmed — 5xx steady, tail latency bounced by ~40ms at 95th for ~30s on internal trace only. no downstream errors.

sam: so PD pages were noisy but not user-impacting. good call.

alex: quick mitigation: increase kv warmup concurrency to 4 for canary hosts and widen busy-window suppression for this alert to 45s. I'll push the small config change now.

maria: doing a soft bump: `kubectl set env deployment/kv-warmup WARMUP_CONCURRENCY=4 --namespace=runtime` — applying.

incident-bot: DeployBot: rollout started for kv-warmup config on canary pool.

sam: thanks. i'm going to label this as transient/no-customer-impact and close PD incident once stable.

jen: can we add a quick tweak to the alert: require sustained >60s before firing for this particular metric? it's too chatty for short warmups.

alex: agree — propose `for: 60s` on rule `runtime.kv.cache.miss_rate_p95`. will open a PR after this.

maria: can we also surface a dashboard panel for kv-warmup vs tail-latency? would help triage next time.

sam: noted. i'll create a small follow-up ticket: `ENG-ops: kv-warmup alert tuning + dashboard` and assign to alex/maria.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD12345 auto-resolved.

alex: config change applied, canary metrics returning to baseline within 2 mins.

maria: verifying logs — miss bursts stopped after warmup concurrency bump.

sam: closing the thread here. no customer impact, low blast radius. follow-ups: PR for `for:60s`, dashboard panel, and ticket for alert tuning.

jen: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: leaving a quick note in #postmortems if anything changes.

incident-bot: Thread closed by sam.
